message:
A few bugs are pretty much guaranteed with a site like this, but here's an important note: When you watch a movie through Google Drive, it sometimes defaults to the lowest quality. I can't fix that from BCAMOVIES+, but you can adjust the quality in Drive's settings.

Also, try out the game and let me know what you think! I'd love feedback, and tell me if you want me to make more games.

I'm making updates and changes pretty much daily, so refresh the site often to see what's new.

Enjoy, and keep it on the DL.
